description: This file defines the 'Request' class within the AWS CRT HTTP namespace, representing an HTTP request with methods for construction, marshalling, unmarshalling, and accessing the request body stream.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request message including method, path, headers, query, and optional body stream.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Request instance with method, path, query parameters, headers, and optional body stream. Throws exception if body_stream is not an instance of InputStream.

methods.name: marshall
methods.description: Serializes the Request object into a buffer for transmission.

methods.name: unmarshall
methods.description: Deserializes a buffer into a Request object.

methods.name: body_stream
methods.description: Returns the body stream associated with the request.

search-terms: body stream in PHP HTTP request
